basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer from Manchester, UK, who recently got into Reddit to find solutions for everyday tech issues. I have a passion for gaming, especially on my Xbox One, and I'm an avid supporter of Chelsea FC. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy exploring new places and contributing to OpenStreetMap to improve map data. My online hours are usually in the evenings after work, where I spend time browsing Reddit or playing games. I'm currently working as a junior IT technician, which keeps me engaged with technology. In a relationship for the past two years.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in technology is mostly self-taught through personal experience and online tutorials. I've always been a problem-solver, which led me to my current job as a junior IT technician. I also have a keen interest in geography, which I explore through contributing to OpenStreetMap.
